name: Fulmination

passives.name: Energized
passives.effects: Moving and basic attacking generates Energize stacks, up to 100.

passives.name: Polarity
passives.effects: Your Energized attacks against targets not hit by your previous Energized attack do not consume any Energize stacks on-hit.

passives.name: Dynamo
passives.effects: When fully Energized, your next basic attack deals bonus magic damage on-hit equal to 13% of the target's current health.

description:
55 Attack Damage
45% Attack Speed
15% Move Speed
Polarity
On Attack, if the target is different from the target you most recently triggered an Energized Attack on, ready Energize.
Dynamo
Energized Attacks deal an additional magic damage based on the Target's Current Health.
